blocked_claims: O_NOFOLLOW protects only the final POSIX path component; no descriptor-anchored ancestor walk is claimed.
O_NONBLOCK closes the FIFO-open hole but does not provide a hard wall-clock bound for every regular filesystem.
Pre/post metadata equality is not a cryptographic or immutable filesystem snapshot.
The Windows implementation was source-reviewed but not built or executed in this cloudtainer.
Focused ASan/UBSan covers only the two changed proof targets; leak detection was disabled.
No arbitrary VFS/power-loss completeness, hostile-worker sandbox, distributed convergence, confidentiality, anonymity, metadata hiding, key lifecycle, or secure erasure is proved.
